title: PoseMotion
description: A motion description: which pose asset is reached at which time. Bone values are not stored here; they are resolved from the pose assets inside the model .blend at render time.

model.description: Path to the .blend the pose assets were enumerated from, recorded for reference.

seed.description: Seed of the random draw; re-running with this seed reproduces the timeline.

duration_ns.description: Length of the timeline in nanoseconds.

event_count.description: Derived: number of poses in the timeline, including the one at t=0.

t_ns.description: Time at which the asset is fully reached, in nanoseconds.

asset.description: Name of the pose asset (an action inside the model .blend).

group.description: Body region the asset drives (left, right, head, body). Events in different groups touch disjoint bones and are layered rather than replacing one another.

pose_event.description: One pose reached at one instant. Every asset is a single-frame pose.
